description: This file declares private functions and macros related to security domain group management in a Wi-Fi driver or similar network component. It includes function prototypes for adding, removing, starting, stopping, and checking the status of security domain members.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_addMember
methods.description: Adds a member to the security domain group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_setMemberEvtHdlrs
methods.description: Sets event handlers for a security domain group member.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_delMember
methods.description: Deletes a member from the security domain group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_startMember
methods.description: Starts a security domain group member.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_stopMember
methods.description: Stops a security domain group member.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_isMemberStarted
methods.description: Checks if a security domain group member is started.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_isMemberRestarting
methods.description: Checks if a security domain group member is restarting.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_restartMember
methods.description: Restarts a security domain group member.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_hasMemberRestarting
methods.description: Checks if any member of the security domain group is restarting.
